path.data-note-seats: Majority is computed over active judgeships by default. Senior judges are supernumerary. The district courts do not usually vote en banc.

path.data-full-name: U.S. District Court for the District of the Virgin Islands
path.data-note: The territorial district courts do not sit en banc, and their judges serve 10-year terms. Judges can serve as “holdovers” if no successor is confirmed by the end of their term.
